thread:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — we need to shift tomorrow's short infra patch window to reduce APAC risk. Original: 02:00-03:00 UTC. New target: 03:30-04:00 UTC. This will be a rolling drain of model-serving nodes; expected micro-outages (~5-10m) per AZ while we apply a kernel/security patch and restart the runtime. Posting here so ops, oncall, and CS can align on paging + customer comms.

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: INC-2026-MAINT-117. Auto-paging rule attached: trigger if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m. Will post status updates to status.redwood.ai when an incident is opened.

Eli Tan: I'll run the patch and follow the canary-first plan. High level runbook: canary in us-west-1, wait 10m smoke, then rolling across zones with 2m buffer between zones. Commands I'll use:
```
# cordon + drain (example)
kubectl cordon node-abc
kubectl drain node-abc --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# re-enable after healthcheck pass
```
We'll disable cluster autoscaler for the window and bump healthcheck thresholds to avoid noisy flaps. Rollback: redeploy previous runtime image and uncordon.

Jordan Lee: I'll draft the status page + support blurb. Proposed status page text (please review):
""
We are performing a planned maintenance on our inference serving fleet affecting parts of us-west and eu-west. Customers may see intermittent 5xx errors or increased latency for brief periods between 03:35–03:55 UTC. Our team is applying a security patch and rolling restarts. Please retry requests; exponential backoff recommended. No data loss expected.
""
Will also prepare targeted emails for Dedicated customers and opt-in webhooks for high-importance tenants.

marta.k: Wording looks good. Add a short line telling customers where to check for live updates (status.redwood.ai) and a note for SDK users: retry with jitter/backoff. Also confirm SLA doesn't change for the maintenance.

Nora Singh: CS will queue pre-emptive messages for the top 10 paying customers and have reps on standby during the window. I'll attach a paste-ready DM template for CS.

Priya Rao: On-call coverage — Jordan will be primary during the window, Eli will be secondary/exec escalation. @oncall-bot please ensure paging goes to Jordan first. If we hit the paging threshold, escalate to Eli after 8 minutes and then to PagerDuty.

oncall-bot: Paging policy updated. Primary: Jordan Lee. Secondary: Eli Tan. Escalation: 8m -> PagerDuty. Reminder: include logs + last 20 req IDs on page.

Jordan Lee: ack, I'll be at my desk from 03:20 UTC. I'll post the exact status page link when it's live and ping CS to send the pre-emptive notes.

StatusPageBot: Draft status update created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/maint-117-draft. Paste for publish: 
```
Incident: Planned maintenance - rolling restart of serving nodes
Start: 03:30 UTC (approx)
Impact: Brief, intermittent 5xx errors and increased latency in affected regions.
Action: Rolling canary + zone-by-zone restart. Team: Eli Tan, Jordan Lee, Priya Rao.
ETA: 03:30-04:00 UTC. Updates will be posted here.
```

Eli Tan: Small ops note — I'll open a temporary maintenance tag in tracing so we can filter false positives in SLO dashboards. Also will push a dashboard snapshot to the #eng-oncall channel before starting.

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Action items:
- Jordan: publish status page + send Dedicated emails (03:10 UTC)
- Nora: CS pre-notify top customers (03:15 UTC)
- Eli: run canary and post smoke results (03:35 UTC)
- Priya: coordinate rollback if needed and hold final go/no-go at 03:25 UTC

Please react with :thumbsup: if you see no blockers. If anyone can't make the window, flag here now so we can reassign.

marta.k: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Eli Tan: :thumbsup:
Nora Singh: :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: Publishing note (post-window) — I'll post a short completion note in this thread with exact start/end times and any customer-facing follow-ups.

(07m later)

Priya Rao: UPDATE: maintenance completed. Actual window 03:33–03:44 UTC. We hit a small hiccup in eu-west canary (2m 5xx spike) and rolled back that zone, re-applied with a config tweak, then completed. No customer SLA breaches. Postmortem in draft, will push to /docs/incidents/INC-2026-MAINT-117.

Jordan Lee: Status page updated to 'Resolved' and emails sent to Dedicated customers. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/maint-117. Nora: CS noted all replies and no escalations.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-MAINT-117 marked resolved by Priya Rao at 03:44 UTC.

Priya Rao: Thanks team — excellent coordination. I'll drop the postmortem and a short internal template for maintenance comms (what we announced vs. what happened) into #eng-postmortems later today.
